subject: Partner Center referral for Contoso - mapping & seller escrow ask
messages:
From: Sara Lindstrom <sara.lindstrom@microsoft.com>
To: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai
Cc: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 14 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Partner Center referral for Contoso - mapping & seller escrow ask

Hi Stephanie,

I'm looping you in from Partner Center — we have an inbound referral for Contoso (enterprise footnote: global manufacturing, ~$12M ARR) that matched to a Redwood listing this morning. Contoso has already agreed to a discovery call; they're most interested in predictable inference throughput and private deployment options.

Two quick asks from the Partner Center side so we can progress the co-sell:
- Can Redwood confirm a named field seller (or team) who will own the initial outreach and intake? Microsoft will hold the referral open while the assigned seller confirms ownership.
- We need a seller consent (DocuSign) to proceed with co-sell tracking and to enable listing visibility in their portal. I attached the minimal intake template and an account export for your mapping.

Files attached: contoso_account_export.csv, referral_intake_template.xlsx

If you can reply with the owner and target timeline (we typically ask for owner confirmation within 72 hours), I will lock the referral to avoid duplicate assignment.

Thanks — happy to hop on a quick call if that helps.

Sara Lindstrom
Senior Partner Manager, Microsoft Azure Marketplace
Azure Partner Sales

From: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai
To: Sara Lindstrom <sara.lindstrom@microsoft.com>
Cc: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 14 May 2027 10:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Partner Center referral for Contoso - mapping & seller escrow ask

Thanks Sara — appreciate the heads up and the attachments.

Quick responses inline:
- Owner: I'll take primary ownership for the intake and initial discovery. I will loop in Vanessa on any field handoff; Karthik, please confirm if you want to be the assigned quota-owner for follow-up motion.
- DocuSign: Please send the seller-consent link to me and to tom.reed@contoso.com (copied below when ready) — we'll sign asap.

Proposed next steps from Redwood:
1) I will use the referral_intake_template.xlsx to capture contact mapping and primary pain points during discovery.
2) Vanessa, can you run the exported account list against our internal owner roster and highlight any prior engagement or existing opportunities? (expected: 1–2 business days)
3) Microsoft to lock the referral for 72 hours once the owner is confirmed; we will return signed consent within that window.

Attaching: referral_intake_template.xlsx (filled skeleton), noted contoso_account_export.csv for your mapping.

Stephanie Nguyen
Head of Field GTM, Redwood Inference
stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai

From: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai
To: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Cc: Sara Lindstrom <sara.lindstrom@microsoft.com>
Date: Fri, 14 May 2027 13:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Partner Center referral for Contoso - mapping & seller escrow ask

Nice — thanks Steph & Sara.

I'll take the account mapping task. Plan:
- Run contoso_account_export.csv against our CRM and list top 10 well-matched accounts by seat and prior support interactions.
- Flag any technical champions we've spoken with previously and mark overlapping internal owners.
- Where there is ambiguity I'll propose an owner based on territory tilt; for any contested accounts I will suggest a split-handshake (seller A manages initial exec intro; seller B owns procurement).

I expect a one-business-day turnaround unless we hit incomplete contact info. I'll drop the spreadsheet back into this thread and attach the 'owner_recs.csv' artifact.

Vanessa Ortiz
Partner Field Ops, Redwood Inference

From: Sara Lindstrom <sara.lindstrom@microsoft.com>
To: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai
Cc: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, AzureMarketplace <azuremarketplace@microsoft.com>
Date: Fri, 14 May 2027 15:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Partner Center referral for Contoso - mapping & seller escrow ask

Great — thanks for the quick response, team.

I've initiated the referral lock and routed the DocuSign seller consent to Stephanie and to the primary Contoso contact (Tom Reed). The DocuSign link: https://www.docusign.com/sign/XYZ-abcdef-123456

Next items for Microsoft:
- We'll mark the referral as 'in progress' for 72 hours (lock expires 2027-05-17T15:42:00Z). If Redwood needs more time, please confirm and we'll extend with a note.
- I'll also open a Partner Center case to request co-sell attribution once you have a signed consent and an initial discovery note.

I'll await the signed consent and Vanessa's owner_recs.csv before we schedule the joint discovery.

Sara

From: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai
To: Sara Lindstrom <sara.lindstrom@microsoft.com>, Tom Reed <tom.reed@contoso.com>
Cc: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: Sat, 15 May 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Partner Center referral for Contoso - mapping & seller escrow ask

Tom / Sara — we've received the DocuSign request and have routed it internally. Tom, welcome — looking forward to the discovery. Stephanie (me) will lead the first call; Vanessa will propose owner_recs by Monday.

For internal tracking: once the seller consent is signed I will update HubSpot (link: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/1234567/company/Contoso) and share the discovery notes. Please keep the referral locked — we plan to return signed consent within the 72-hour window.

Thanks all — proposed tentative discovery: Tue 2027-05-18 10:00 PT. If that works for Tom we'll send a calendar invite.

—Stephanie
